name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 (Convoy)
description: Convoy multiplayer for SCS's trucking simulator. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); needs server packages exported from the game client.
notes: REQUIRED: the server refuses to start without server_packages.sii and server_packages.dat — generate them in the ETS2 game client (console command: export_server_packages, files land in your ETS2 Documents folder; the client's DLC/mod set must match the server's) and upload both next to server_config.sii via the file manager. -homedir . keeps everything inside the server directory. Windows hosts: set the start command override to bin\win_x64\eurotrucks2_server.exe with the same arguments. American Truck Simulator has its own server app (2239530) and works the same way.
